breakdown_bounce_rate_other 2329b71f73ed.sql:
WITH g AS (SELECT "referrer_source" AS r, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "views" = 1)::DOUBLE / count(*) AS b,
				count(*) FILTER (WHERE "views" = 1) AS n, count(*) AS c
			FROM sessions WHERE "project_id" = 3 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-29' AND DATE '2026-09-10' GROUP BY ALL),
		top AS (SELECT * FROM g ORDER BY b DESC, r ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 2) SELECT r, b, n, c FROM (
					SELECT 0 AS o, r, b, n, c FROM top
					UNION ALL
					SELECT 1, 'Other', count(*) FILTER (WHERE "views" = 1)::DOUBLE / count(*), count(*) FILTER (WHERE "views" = 1), count(*)
					FROM sessions s WHERE "project_id" = 3 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-29' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM top WHERE top.r IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s."referrer_source")
					HAVING count(*) > 0)
				ORDER BY o, b DESC, r ASC NULLS LAST
